reviewItem.question: If an exposed environment does nothing about "e44ae96c0706ca15c8a7cd80ba352f2e19e4857e: fix(appset): generated app errors should use the default requeue", what happens, and is that review or action? proposed: behavior-change

consequence.statement: Error handling for ApplicationSet-generated applications will use the default requeue behavior, which may affect retry timing and frequency for failed application generation.

proposed.statement: Error handling for ApplicationSet-generated applications now uses the default requeue behavior instead of a previous non-default requeue strategy.
